name: Onee-chan no Ama Ero Lesson 2 ~Otonari no Kyonyuu Onee-chan ni Ippai Amayakasareru Mecha Ero Life~
original_name: お姉ちゃんのあまエロレッスン2 ～お隣の巨乳お姉ちゃんにイッパイ甘やかされるめちゃエロライフ～
source:
The protagonist, Souta, and the sisters next door, Seika and Rikka, are close childhood friends. However, as he grows up, he begins to feel attracted to the sisters. Since they've been like brother and sister since they were little, he doesn't know whether his feelings for them are "like" or "love", which makes him anxious.

One day, just as summer vacation is about to begin, he receives a love letter. The letter triggers a change in his relationship with the two sisters. This is the start of naughty lessons, being pampered by the two sisters who are getting serious about him!

[Translated from [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc089/index.html#story]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
主人公苍太和隔壁的姐妹清香和立花是儿时的好朋友。然而，随着他长大，他开始被姐妹们所吸引。由于他们从小就如兄妹一般，他不知道自己对他们的感情是“喜欢”还是“爱”，这让他很焦虑。

有一天，暑假即将开始，他收到一封情书。这封信引发了他与两姐妹的关系的变化。这就是调皮课的开始，被认真对待他的两姐妹宠着！

[翻译自[url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc089/index.html#story]官方网站[/url]]
